component.name: NMessenger
component.summary: Classic instant messenger inspired by Windows Live Messenger

description.p: NMessenger is a native, end-to-end encrypted messaging client inspired by the golden era of Windows Live Messenger. It combines the expressive nostalgia of 2000s instant messengers with modern high-performance cryptography, real-time communication, voice/video calls, and screen sharing.
First alpha release of NMessenger featuring end-to-end encryption, nostalgic UI, game spaces, and screen sharing.
